quality_notes.note: The machine card claimed two objects released from the same height landing near-simultaneously violates free-fall physics. This is a physics misjudgment: at low speed near Earth surface, objects of different mass released together should land near-simultaneously (Galilean equivalence). The issue text retains the model claim for transparency but is not endorsed.
